purpose: Portray an appearance or action as almost reaching an extreme.
keywords: Vない stem + んばかりに / の / だ; する → せんばかり
He pleaded as though he were about to cry.
The tree swayed as if it were about to fall.
Everyone was so delighted they seemed ready to leap into the air.
formation: Vない stem + んばかりに / の / だ; する → せんばかり
restrictions: The extreme action need not actually occur.
mistake: Do not add ん to the full ない form.
